description: Self-hosted secure AI gateway client — forwards an OIDC bearer token to the operator-configured SecRouter endpoint for authentication.

expectedBehaviors.purpose: Forward OpenAI-compatible requests to your self-hosted SecRouter gateway
expectedBehaviors.justification: SecRouter is self-hosted. The plugin sends requests only to the gateway URL you configure; that gateway enforces authentication, per-user policy, deny-by-default egress, and audit. No third-party endpoint is contacted by the plugin.
The bearer token — a short-lived OIDC JWT issued by your IdP — authenticates the request to your SecRouter gateway. It is sent only to the configured endpoint, over TLS.

securityNotes: No wallet, funds, or cryptocurrency of any kind — the x402 payment layer of the upstream fork was removed entirely.
The gateway is self-hosted; prompts and data stay within the operator's boundary and its approved providers.
Requests carry a standard OIDC bearer token; the gateway enforces deny-by-default egress, per-user policy, and hash-chained audit.
